description:
Issue summary: Customer reports that exporting a dashboard panel to CSV returns an empty file (0 data rows) when the panel's filter uses OR conditions that include a tracehook parameter. Impact: BrightCart's scheduled digest relied on the CSV to attach tracehook links to alerts; missing rows caused alerts to be delivered without context and a missed escalation. Environment: prod (us-east), BrightCart org ID 8162, dashboard id db-94a1. Example export job id: export-20260313-8162-77.

Observed behavior: The console UI shows matching rows in the panel preview, but the bulk export job completes successfully and the CSV contains only headers (no data rows). This happens reproducibly when the filter contains OR conditions mixing tracehook tokens and other predicates (e.g., tracehook.session_id = "abc" OR route = "payments"). Exports that use only AND conditions or that omit tracehook tokens succeed.

Notes: Customer first noticed at 2026-03-13 15:22 PDT when scheduled report delivered an empty attachment. They attached a screenshot of the panel preview and the CSV.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Login to BrightCart org (org id 8162) in prod us-east.
2) Open dashboard db-94a1 and locate panel 'Payments session activity'.
3) Set panel filter to: tracehook.session_id = "abc123" OR route = "payments".
4) Click 'Download CSV' (bulk export).
5) Observe exported file CSV has headers but zero data rows.
6) Modify filter to use AND instead of OR or remove tracehook clause and repeat export -> CSV contains rows.
expected_result: CSV export should include the same rows that are shown in the panel preview for the given time range and filter (including when the filter has OR conditions referencing tracehook tokens).
actual_result: Export job returns 200 and a CSV file with headers only. Panel preview shows data rows for the same filter.

investigation_notes:
Investigation timeline:
- 2026-03-13 22:40 UTC: Reproduced against BrightCart prod org from support console using their dashboard and a synthetic tracehook token -> export returns empty CSV but UI preview shows rows.
- Confirmed export-service v1.9.4 running in us-east.
- Captured SQL/IR emitted by query planner: when OR is present and one side references a tracehook-augmented column (nullable string), the sanitizer performs an incorrect boolean normalization that rewrites the OR into an expression with IS NOT NULL checks that can be optimized away by the planner when a partial index on tracehook metadata exists.
- Root cause hypothesis: query-sanitizer component incorrectly hoists or collapses OR branches involving tracehook tokens during boolean simplification. This interacts with the planner's partial-index-aware predicate pushdown, producing a plan that returns zero rows for combinations that are valid in the preview path (preview uses an alternate execution path that evaluates filters at the application layer after enrichment).
- Reproduced with a minimal test case against staging; created unit test demonstrating sanitizer rewrite mismatch.
resolution:
Patch deployed: export-service v1.9.5 that fixes boolean-simplifier to preserve OR branches referencing nullable tracehook columns and avoid hoisting IS NOT NULL checks. Patch includes unit tests and an integration test that mirrors the panel preview path.
Rollout: Canary started 2026-03-14 01:40 UTC at 5% -> 25% -> 100% by 02:10 UTC in us-east. All subsequent reproduction attempts now return expected rows in exported CSV.
Workaround (prior to patch): Instruct customer to either (a) change OR to explicit parentheses and avoid using tracehook token on one side (e.g., (route = 'payments') OR (tracehook.session_id IS NOT NULL AND tracehook.session_id = 'abc123')), or (b) use the panel's 'Download visible rows' feature which uses the preview path.
Customer communications: CS issued a one-week service credit for missed digest delivery and coordinated a re-run of the scheduled export.
Follow-ups: Add a cross-check in export CI to run integration tests against typical tracehook filters; add dashboard-level telemetry to surface export-preview divergence.

2026-03-13 16:05 PDT - Diego Morales (SRE): Confirmed reproduction in prod using their org id. Marked P1 and added labels. Noted export-service v1.9.4 in us-east. Involving platform/query-engine team. Linked issue SUP-902468 as possibly related.

2026-03-13 20:12 UTC - Priya Rao (Platform Eng): Found sanitizer boolean rewrite that collapses OR branches when nullable tracehook column present. Created PR github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7289 with fix and tests. Requesting canary deploy to verify.

2026-03-14 02:20 UTC - Diego Morales (SRE): Deployed export-service v1.9.5 to us-east; canary to full rollout completed at 02:10 UTC. Verified export-20260314 test runs return data rows and customer-provided dashboard now exports correctly. Notified CS to re-run their scheduled job and issued credit. Closing as resolved.

2026-03-14 03:05 PDT - Aaron Patel (Customer Success): Notified BrightCart of fix, scheduled re-run for 2026-03-14 10:00 PDT, confirmed they received export with expected rows and tracehook links present. Customer accepted the one-week credit.
